free_text: 66y male, PSA 8.3, PSAD 0.206, PI-RADS 2, prior positive biopsy. Decision is no biopsy as prior biopsy grade is not recorded and lesion is described as benign on new MRI. Rising PSA velocity of 0.78 ng/mL/yr argues against further tissue sampling. Alternative plan is to follow PSA and re-image if it rises.
